attr.title: Sonic The Hedgehog 4: Episode II
attr.desc: Sonic The Hedgehog 4: Episode II through a native AArch64 Android so-loader. V6 supports adaptive video and audio backends, native resolution, controller input and a visible first-run validator. BYO-data: Android v3.0.0-109 game files are not included.
attr.inst: Copy the legally obtained Android v3.0.0-109 ARM64 split_config.arm64_v8a.apk and split_packs.apk, or one complete .apks/.apkm/merged APK export, into sonic4ep2 and launch once to validate and extract.
